COUNT(*) retains its BIGINT type.","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hour, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime)) AS trips FROM trips"},{"query_id":"q01","reason":"Counts each distinct pickup timestamp before combining counts by extracted hour. The explicit cast preserves the original BIGINT count type; NULL timestamps remain grouped.","sql":"SELECT EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hour, CAST(SUM(timestamp_trips) AS BIGINT) AS trips FROM (SELECT tpep_pickup_datetime, COUNT(*) AS timestamp_trips FROM trips GROUP BY tpep_pickup_datetime) AS timestamp_counts GROUP BY 1"},{"query_id":"q05","reason":"Applies the original day-of-month predicate before window counting and DISTINCT. Preserves duplicate counts, NULL route keys, anomalous dates, and the BIGINT count type.","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT PULocationID AS pickup, DOLocationID AS dropoff, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY PULocationID, DOLocationID) AS trips FROM trips WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7"},{"query_id":"q05","reason":"Aggregates by route and extracted day before filtering and combining counts. Retains the exact day-of-month condition and casts the combined count back to BIGINT.","sql":"SELECT pickup, dropoff, CAST(SUM(day_trips) AS BIGINT) AS trips FROM (SELECT PULocationID AS pickup, DOLocationID AS dropoff, EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS pickup_day, COUNT(*) AS day_trips FROM trips GROUP BY 1, 2, 3) AS route_days WHERE pickup_day <= 7 GROUP BY 1, 2"}]}
